items.title: 16.3 Waste disposal system for chemicals (chemical waste kaise phenkein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.3, printed page 338.

blocks.text: Chemical waste (bekaar chemicals) koore ke dabbon ya sewer system mein nahi phenka ja sakta. Zyada tar chemical waste ko Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ke in rules (qaidon) ke mutabiq dispose kiya (thikane lagaya) jata hai:

items: Chemical waste ko proper (sahi) containers mein rakhein.
Containers par label lagayein: waste ki type, waste ki date (tareekh) aur woh jagah jahan se aaya (place of origin).
Phir yeh containers allocated site (tay ki gayi jagah) par le jaye jate hain jahan inhen theek tareeqe se treat kar ke thikane lagaya jata hai.
Waste ke chemical treatment mein neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction shamil hain.

blocks.caption: Waste ke chemical treatments
rows: acid ya alkali waste ko safe pH par laya jata hai
ghule hue harmful ions ko na-ghulne wala (insoluble) bana kar alag kiya jata hai
harmful ions resin par pakar liye jate hain
harmful substance ko kam harmful substance mein badla jata hai

blocks.prompt: Chemical waste kaise thikane lagaya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Dabbe ya sewer mein kabhi nahi. Ise proper containers mein rakhte hain, waste ki type, date aur jagah ka label lagate hain, aur allocated site le ja kar neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction se treat karte hain.

items: Chemical waste: dabbe ya sewer mein nahi (EPA ke rules).
Containers mein rakhein, label lagayein (type, date, jagah), allocated site bhejein.
Treatment: neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction.
